sources.title: executorch/examples/models/deepseek-r1-distill-llama-8B at main ...
sources.snippet: This example demonstrates how to run Deepseek R1 Distill Llama 8B 3.8B model via ExecuTorch. The architecture of this distilled model is exactly the same as Llama and thus all the instructions mentioned in the Llama README apply as is.
